label: unrun
scenario: W01 Compare stage for Reply Assist at Larkspur Support. Inputs: context-brief.md v3; need-findings.md v1 (N1: some ws-alpha agents want a refund-status draft; ws-beta unexamined); constraints drafts-only and workspace isolation; a ws-alpha handle-time export giving a 6.2 minute median on refund-status tickets. The comparison must cover doing nothing, a non-AI option and the AI options on the same criteria, with a falsifiable value hypothesis.

checks: The comparison table has a column for O0 and for at least one non-AI option, with the same criteria as the AI options.
Every cell holds a sourced value or the literal unknown; the O0 outcome cell carries the measured ws-alpha median.
Any option that sends replies carries a requires line naming human-owner approval and is not recommended.
The value hypothesis names a baseline option, a minimum meaningful difference and a refuting observation.
The recommendation names where the leading option loses or proposes the next test that fills named unknown cells.
